rationale: Two major findings: (1) inferNodeType uses a truthiness check on workflow_id that silently drops unconfigured sub_workflow nodes to CUSTOM type on deserialization; (2) WorkflowStateIcon returns null for sub_workflow nodes, breaking execution-drawer layout for any existing workflow with workflow_id states. All 19 acceptance criteria pass. No security or critical issues. 1 deferred: ISSUE_FIELD_MAP/NODE_TYPE_TO_CONFIG_ARRAY asymmetry, low impact while feature is hidden.

business_review.criterion: nodeTemplates entry: HIDDEN category, icon null
inferNodeType returns SUB_WORKFLOW for workflow_id (after tool_id, before custom_node_id)
createState SUB_WORKFLOW case with correct shape

standards_review.notes: Branch commits use conventional format 'feat(EPMCDME-11609): lowercase' — does not match required regex pattern. Resolved at squash merge where MR title follows the required format.

findings.problem: inferNodeType uses a truthiness check: `if (state.workflow_id)`. An empty string is falsy, so any sub_workflow state created with the default workflow_id: '' (from createStateAction) falls through to NodeTypes.CUSTOM on deserialization.
findings.impact: An unconfigured sub_workflow node (workflow_id = '') round-trips as CUSTOM type after serialize/deserialize, permanently losing its type on any save-reload cycle.
findings.recommendation: Change to: `if (state.workflow_id !== undefined) return NodeTypes.SUB_WORKFLOW` — also update the test fixture to cover the empty-string case.

findings.problem: WorkflowStateIcon returns null for NodeTypes.SUB_WORKFLOW. The execution drawer caller (WorkflowDrawerListItem) renders it inline in a flex row with size/margin CSS classes. When null is returned those classes apply to nothing — no icon slot, no margins, the node name renders flush against the leading chevron.
findings.impact: Any existing backend workflow with workflow_id states that appears in the execution drawer renders with broken spacing. The HIDDEN category only prevents new nodes being added in the editor; it does not prevent existing YAML workflows with sub_workflow states from being displayed in the execution drawer.
findings.recommendation: In WorkflowStateIcon return a sized placeholder instead of null: `if (!Comp) return <span className={className} aria-hidden />`. Alternatively wrap the call site in WorkflowDrawerListItem with a null-safe fallback.
